scheduling: daily GitHub Actions scan for public repositories; daily connected WANGA work loop for connector-visible projects and Library sources

private_content_policy.public_reports: Never include private or unknown-visibility repository names, paths, excerpts, or source contents.
private_content_policy.private_content_collection: Only through an authorized connected runtime; preserve source locator/hash and store review output only in an approved private destination.
private_content_policy.raw_conversation_export: PRIVATE_REVIEW_ONLY until manually reviewed/redacted; never auto-publish transcripts to Wix.

git_policy.other_repository_writes: Only when change belongs to that repository and a branch/PR can be opened; otherwise record an integration proposal in WANGA-LAB.

access_notes: A connected GitHub repository list is an access snapshot, not proof of ownership or public visibility.
GitHub Actions GITHUB_TOKEN is not assumed to have account-wide access.
CROSS_REPO_READ_TOKEN is optional and must be provided as a secret with approved minimum read scope.
Private or unknown visibility content is excluded from public artifacts.
